description: Southeast US deciduous woodlands. Rich forage, real winters in the north of range. Your first classroom.
name: Southeast Woodlands

fall.note: Harvest season. Nuts, persimmons, last greens. Fatten up.

spring.note: Greens return. Hungry season ends — if you make it.

summer.note: Berries, heat, snakes. Water is everywhere; food takes work.

winter.note: The boss. Nuts and stored food or nothing. Game gets bold.
